name: Mauritania

flag.description: A green field with a yellow crescent opening upward beneath a yellow five-pointed star in the centre, and horizontal red stripes along the top and bottom edges.
flag.symbolism: Green and the crescent and star represent Islam, yellow the Sahara, and the red stripes the blood of those who fought for independence.

hook: Mauritania is green with an upward-cupped yellow crescent and star, and since 2017 red stripes along the top and bottom.
trivia: The red stripes were added in 2017 after a constitutional referendum.
Mauritania's iron-ore trains, up to about 2.5 km long, are among the longest and heaviest trains in the world.
The Richat Structure, a 40 km-wide set of concentric rings known as the 'Eye of the Sahara', lies in Mauritania.
